# Finishing and packaging medicine
These reactions consume the full quantities and create a finished item. They are separate from making the medicinal reagent. Keep enough room in your mixing container for all ingredients.
## Antidote
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 100u refined antidote + 20u silicon
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1 finished antidote.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals poison, radiation damage. ## Antidote syringe
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 15u refined antidote + 5u oil + 5u phosphorus
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1 finished antidote syringe.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals poison, radiation damage. ## Radaway
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 20u radaway + 5u oil + 5u phosphorus
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1 finished RadAway.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals radiation damage; Reduces feralization progression. ## Stimpak
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 25u stimpak + 5u oil + 5u phosphorus
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1 finished stimpak.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals burn, brute, airloss damage; Reduces bleeding; At 30u or more: Can cause vomiting. ## Dirty stimpak
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 25u dirty stimpak + 5u oil + 5u phosphorus
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1 finished dirty stimpak.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Applies recovery status; Heals burn, brute, airloss damage; Causes radiation, poison damage; Reduces bleeding; At 30u or more: Heals burn, brute, airloss damage; At 30u or more: Causes poison damage; At 50u or more: Causes poison damage. ## Bitterdrink
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 50u bitterdrink + 10u silicon
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1 finished Bitterdrink.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals radiation, poison damage; At 25u or more: Can cause vomiting; Reduces feralization progression. ## Smelling salts
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 5u sulfur + 5u table salt + 5u ammonia
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1 finished smelling salts.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals asphyxiation, cold damage; At 0u or more: While critically injured: Heals asphyxiation, poison, brute, burn damage; At 20u or more: Causes asphyxiation, poison damage; Removes stun; Removes knockdown; Causes jittering; Can cause vomiting. ## Ointment
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 5u agave nectar extract + 5u water + 5u ash
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1 finished Ointment1.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals blunt, burn damage. Apply to the patient; this is the field item, not the similarly named reagent.
